parameters.description: The file's `id` returned by upload or list.
parameters.name: file_id

404.description: File not found, deleted, or expired.

summary:
Retrieve metadata for a single file by ID. Errors with 404 if the file
doesn't exist, has been deleted, or has passed its `expires_at`.

bytes.description: The size of the file, in bytes.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for file creation time.

expires_at.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) for file expiry time. null if file does not expire.

id.description: The file identifier, which can be used in other API requests.

object.description: The object type, which is always `file`. Only included for compatability.

public_url.description: Public URL for the file. Only present when the file has an active public URL.

public_url_expires_at.description:
Unix timestamp (seconds) when the public URL expires. Only present when
the public URL has an independent expiry.

purpose.description: The intended purpose of the uploaded file. Only included for OAI compatability.
